Its portfolio spans Vitamin B, Vitamin E, Vitamin B Complex, Iron, Nasal Care and Omega-3, sold pan-India through direct and indirect distribution channels that include distributors, pharmacies and chemists, with patients as the end consumers. sk.overview: India-focused branded pharmaceutical formulations sector operating within the Indian Pharmaceutical Market (IPM).
